questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Limpopo Lillies or Eastern Storm?
questions.explanation: Eastern Storm lead 15-4 across 19 meetings (List A).

questions.question: At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: At which ground did Maryka Kirchoff record their career-best innings (73*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Kei on 2015/02/22.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Runs' in the 22/23 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 386.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2018 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2018.

questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Adele van Eck holds it with 17.
